checks.name: Galois_stability
checks.detail: Every Rat-algebra automorphism acts by composing the stored residue embedding, preserves the actual place, and transports the actual value. Ramification membership is unchanged because ramIdx is a place invariant. Infinity is fixed. Quantification is over all automorphisms.

checks.name: simple_zeros_poles_and_zero_branch_exclusion
checks.detail: The reduced divisor A has coefficient one exactly on Tprime. Exact polar realization gives ord(f)=-1 on Tprime and ord(f)>=0 outside it; psi=f inverse therefore has order one on Tprime and <=0 elsewhere. Every actual zero belongs to Tprime and has index one via the minpoly-at-zero lemma. Hence zero cannot be a branch value. Poles are retained as value none and infinity is explicitly inserted in S.

checks.name: all_places_chain_rule_and_avoidance
checks.detail: The open chain rule quantifies over every QbarPoint and all lists. Every actual place admits a point through an embedding of its finite residue field, so the parent proves the condition for all proper places, including infinity. If psi ramifies, its value is in S; otherwise positivity forces its integer index to equal one and the ramification of phi is supplied by H. For every P in T, psi evaluates to zero and H(0) avoids {0,1,infinity}.

checks.name: actual_ramification_indices
checks.detail: Curve ramification uses ord of the minimal polynomial of the actual full residue element at regular places and minus actual order at poles. P1 polynomial ramification is rootMultiplicity of p-p(z), and its value at infinity is p.natDegree; Mobius ramification is one. The universal chain rule asserts precisely the product of these actual quantities.

checks.name: Riemann_polar_realization_shape
checks.detail: Actual finite-dimensional L(A), the upper bound with actual ell(0), and eventual degree-minus-defect equality imply strict inclusion for L(A-P) inside L(A), using positive actual residue degree. The finite union argument avoids all insufficient pole loci in A.support. The dimension layer derives eventual linearity from actual principal degrees, approximation and the actual Q(u)-basis power family. No assumption that the constant field is exactly Q is used.

checks.name: empty_T_and_integer_thresholds
checks.detail: Tprime has cardinal T.card + N1.toNat + 1, so it is nonempty even for T empty and negative N1. Every degree(P)>=1 makes degree(A)>=N1. A place in Tprime witnesses nonzero order and thus transcendence of psi. This excludes a zero or algebraic-constant inverse from the construction.

checks.name: N_degenerate_boundaries
checks.detail: No new hypothesis N>=4 or division by N*(N-3) occurs in this construction. Model 0 is impossible already: its equation would assert 1+1=1 in characteristic zero; independently finite_u and positive finrank contradict degree_u=0. For any existing Model 1, 2, or 3 the generic curve-field argument still applies. The positive canonical-degree restriction belongs to later StrictQ consumers and is not silently used here.

checks.name: cusp_finiteness_constants_and_support
checks.detail: cusps is exactly the union of support(ord phi) and the positive-order support of phi-1. Both finite-support facts are provided in the prior curve-field layer. This works even for constants using the existing ord(0)=0 convention. The cusp/value equivalence is used only for transcendental functions, so it does not incorrectly classify the identically zero or one function.
